task: The six NUAA runs of the C5 comparison pre-registered in the PR A package (PROTOCOL.md §4, §6 (n), §8, §11): 72 new trainings of AttackNetV1, AttackNetV2_1 and AttackNetV2_2, in six runs of 12 (anet_v1_p4, anet_v2_1_p4, anet_v2_2_p4, then the same at patience 12), one process each, positions of plan/run_matrix.csv (folds 1-4, seeds 42, 43, 44), arm B, fitting 1,400 and dev 400 frames per unit, the recipe and trainer of the technical trial (pad_anet_comparison.anet_trainer), CPU only, 10 intra-op and 10 inter-op threads; fitting and dev only, no test frame
authorisation: PROTOCOL.md §11 of the PR A package: the 72 trainings start after the pull request with the command and configuration of the runs is published and its link is on the C5 card, unless the coordinator states otherwise on the card; the evaluation code and configuration are published, with the link on the card, before the NUAA test is read. Order of the official commands: this pull request published and its link on the C5 card; then check-estimator (PROTOCOL.md §3), not before the link; then the six runs in the order of plan/run_order.csv
operations: results/ is versioned: after check-estimator, and after each run, the work tree is not clean, and check-estimator and run, the only commands that check the work tree, refuse until a commit is made (after the link of this pull request on the C5 card: check-estimator, commit, then each of the six runs in the order of run_order.csv followed by a commit); check-estimator and each run are launched from the repository root, from a zsh with setopt nobgnice, as nohup zsh delivery/anetrun/launch.zsh <arguments> > <a log file outside the repository> 2>&1 &, which runs caffeinate -dims .venv/bin/python -I -B scripts/pad_anet_run.py <arguments>; SIGUSR1 to the pid in status.json stops the command as INCOMPLETE at the next check; SIGUSR1 is sent only for a cause outside the results (for example the machine must be released), never after looking at the histories or the dev outcomes of the run, and the cause is stated in the report; one heavy process at a time on the machine; check-machine and check-inputs before each command. The launch script delivery/anetrun/launch.zsh stops if its nice value is not 0, runs check-machine, check-inputs and the command in this order (the command only if both pass) and writes, outside the repository, a conditions file per command, copied unchanged by the author after each official command into the folder of the records of that run: operating system, power mode and power source (pmset), the nice value of the shell, the number of TF_NUM_ variables set, commit and number of lines of git status --porcelain, load and CPU usage at the start and at the end, the outputs of check-machine and check-inputs, the command and its exit code

estimator_check.cap_unit: minutes of wall time (elapsed real time, not CPU time)
estimator_check.rule: PROTOCOL.md §3: as in C2, the estimator first reproduces the statistics of run 20261114-BNRECAL-a10a082 within the tolerance of PRs #27 and #28 before the runs, otherwise the work stops; the check is that of pad_arch_run check-estimator (the 36 models of the run, both criteria of nuaa_bn_test.recal_check, cap of the PR #27 configuration, 240 minutes of wall time); a run needs a PASS of it made with this configuration and this code

machine_rule.consequence: the rule of C2 (pad_arch_run.machine_rule, thread_environment_rule, threads_rule) applied to the record of the official C5 trial 20261122-ANETTRIAL-a951ed0: the same machine model, the same versions, the same thread record (requested and effective 10 and 10, set by the runner, environment variables absent); before any folder, in check-machine, check-inputs, check-estimator and run; a difference stops the command, nothing trained

sequence: phase 1, for each of the 12 positions in order: the fitting and dev frames of the unit assembled and their keys checked against the card of the accepted run; the training (pad_anet_comparison.anet_trainer, the model built with the registry); rule (n) on the history and on the restored weights; the in-memory dev scored; the checkpoint saved; the card; the dev scored with the saved checkpoint (nuaa_folds_run.tf_scorer), its logits and the val_loss checked against the card. Phase 2, after the 12 trainings, for each evaluable model: the checkpoint reloaded and checked against the registry; the ordinary dev; the BN statistics re-estimated on its fitting set (copy in memory); the consistency pass; the re-estimated dev; the checks of PR #27; the agreement with the phase-1 scores; thresholds, decisions and counts of both BN states. The sequence of pad_arch_run (C2) with the AttackNet trainer, the registry and rule (n)

checkpoint.format: .keras (model.save of Keras 2.15), the format of the accepted runs; read back with tf.keras.models.load_model(compile=False)
checkpoint.when: saved by this runner right after the trainer returned: the weights restored by the trainer (EarlyStopping restore_best_weights, or set_weights when the epochs end first), model.save of Keras 2.15 to a .keras file, written to a temporary name and renamed, as nuaa_folds_run.default_trainer

non_evaluable.rule: rule (n) of the pre-registration (PROTOCOL.md §6 (k)/(n), pad_anet_definitions.training_outcome): a non-finite value in the history does not stop the run; the quantity and the first non-finite epoch are recorded; the restored epoch is that of the smallest finite val_loss; without a finite val_loss, or with non-finite restored weights, the model is not evaluable: no checkpoint, no phase 2
non_evaluable.in_memory_dev: before the checkpoint is saved, the dev and the fitting are scored with the model in memory in the ordinary state (pad_anet_comparison.forward_checked, inference only: no state of the model, no seed and no recorded epoch time changes): non-finite scores or logits make the model not evaluable, without checkpoint
non_evaluable.fitting_scores: the fitting is scored in both BN states: in the ordinary state by the in-memory pass of phase 1 (non_evaluable.in_memory_dev), in the re-estimated state by the consistency pass of phase 2; non-finite scores or logits there, or on the dev in either BN state, make the model not evaluable
non_evaluable.statistics: non-finite re-estimated statistics (the message of nuaa_bn_recalibration) make the model not evaluable, before any output of its phase 2 is written
non_evaluable.record: a not evaluable model keeps its card in restricted/; a model found not evaluable in phase 2 keeps its checkpoint and phase-1 dev scores in restricted/, marked not evaluable in models.csv, and the evaluation does not score it on the test (amended PROTOCOL.md §6 (k)/(n)); models.csv, summary.json and report.md give the status 'not evaluable' with the reason; it does not change the outcome of the run; no new attempt with the same seed for it

estimator.estimator: the estimator of PR #27 (nuaa_bn_recalibration.recalibrate), extended to networks with branches by pad_arch_run.reestimate (the order checked on the graph), on an in-memory copy; only moving_mean and moving_variance assigned; every other tensor checked bit-identical
estimator.order_rule: LivenessNet (check-estimator only): the order of PR #27; each AttackNet: the order of the registry (pad_anet_models.bn_order), the order of the technical trial, checked on the graph by pad_arch_run.reestimate

dev_evaluation.threshold: the EER threshold of the project (pad_arch_definitions.condition_threshold) on the dev of the fold with the scores of the model in the same BN state; attack if score > threshold, also at 0.5
dev_evaluation.one_class: definition (a) (pad_arch_definitions.one_class_run): per model and BN state, on the dev of its fold, at 0.5
dev_evaluation.agreement: the binding agreement of C2 between the phase-1 scorer and the evaluator on the ordinary dev (pad_arch_run.evaluator_agreement, tolerances of PR #27): a disagreement gives the outcome MISMATCH and no public result

cap.source: plan/run_caps.csv of the PR A package, column cap_wall_hours of the run, read, not rewritten
cap.unit: hours of wall time (elapsed real time, not CPU time)
cap.checks: as in C2: before every training, at the end of every epoch and before every inference pass; at the cap the run stops as INCOMPLETE, the model in progress in phase 1 is discarded, the complete models are kept and reported

after_stop: a choice of the author, recorded in the amended PROTOCOL.md §6 (k)/(n) of this delivery, which replaces the pre-registered sentence 'resumed only for the missing trainings': a run stopped at its cap, by SIGUSR1, by a FAIL, a MISMATCH or an interruption is not resumed within its folder; it keeps its folder and outcome and, after its outcome has been reported on the C5 card, is repeated as a new attempt in a new folder from position 1, with the same seeds, code and configuration, before the evaluation, as in C2; the repetition retrains every position, those not evaluable included, and their outcome in the last attempt is the one evaluated; a run is never repeated because of a not evaluable model; the evaluation reads, for each of the six runs, only the last attempt, which must be PASS, with phase 1 complete for the 12 positions (not evaluable models included)
attempts: a choice of the author: as in C2: --attempt N required, the last attempt of the same run in the output root + 1; suffix -r<k>; official output root results/anetrun; another root outside the repository only with --unofficial-out-root, recorded as not official; --date only with --unofficial-out-root (an official run id carries the date of the launch); an official run needs an official check-estimator

choices_of_the_author.sequence: a choice of the author: the two phases and their order, as in C2 (sequence)
choices_of_the_author.in_memory_dev: a choice of the author: the dev and the fitting scored with the model in memory in the ordinary state before the checkpoint is saved, for rule (n) (non_evaluable.in_memory_dev)
choices_of_the_author.checkpoint: a choice of the author: the checkpoint saved by this runner right after the trainer returns, as in C2 (checkpoint.when)
choices_of_the_author.card_check: a choice of the author: the card check of C2 (pad_arch_run.card_problems) with the non-finite history values read as +inf, so that the restored epoch expected is that of the smallest finite val_loss
choices_of_the_author.estimator_check_process: a choice of the author: check-estimator as a command of its own before the runs, the check of C2 (estimator_check.rule)
choices_of_the_author.after_stop: a choice of the author: no resume within the folder, a new attempt from position 1, the last attempt evaluated (after_stop)
choices_of_the_author.launch_conditions: a choice of the author: the launch script delivery/anetrun/launch.zsh, which writes a conditions file per command with the launch conditions (operations)
choices_of_the_author.attempts: a choice of the author: the attempt rule and the unofficial output root (attempts)
choices_of_the_author.machine_scope: a choice of the author: the machine model and versions compared with the C5 trial, not the physical unit (machine_rule)
choices_of_the_author.threads_record: a choice of the author: the whole thread record of the C5 trial compared, environment variables included (machine_rule)
choices_of_the_author.evaluator_agreement: a choice of the author: the binding agreement between the phase-1 scorer and the evaluator, outcome MISMATCH (dev_evaluation.agreement)
choices_of_the_author.dev_frames: a choice of the author: the dev frames checked per fold across the models of the run and the two BN states (one network per run; in C2 the check was between the two networks of a unit)
choices_of_the_author.outputs: a choice of the author: the names and columns of the public and restricted files, the run id YYYYMMDD-ANETRUN-<v1|v2_1|v2_2>-p<4|12>-<commit>[-r<k>] and the folder results/anetrun
choices_of_the_author.deviation_record: a choice of the author: the two amendments of PROTOCOL.md of PR A (§7, the order of publication of the trial; §6 (k)/(n), the repetition of a stopped run) recorded in an amended copy in this delivery, the original kept unchanged

test: no test frame is assembled or evaluated, no test score or metric is read. What each command reads. check-machine: this configuration and, through pad_anet_comparison.load_config, the configuration of PR A with the files it pins (no frame, no checkpoint); the trial record of PR A. check-inputs and run: this configuration; the configuration of PR A and what pad_anet_comparison.load_config and load_inputs read (the C2 pre-registration and the configurations it pins, the PR #27 configuration, the C2 trial record, the public status.json and results.json of the C2 evaluation, the architecture file, the code); the code files pinned here and this file; the status.json and trial.json of the official C5 trial and the SHA256SUMS of the PR A package that lists them; run_matrix.csv, run_order.csv and run_caps.csv, compared with the files regenerated from the configuration of PR A, the public files of the C2 evaluation and the trial; the PR #28 configuration (bytes, for its SHA-256); what pad_arch_comparison.load_inputs reads (its TEST_READ: the five M2 manifests, the cache hashed whole, the extracted frames file loaded whole, both frame files also holding frames of the held-out subjects, the cells and folds runs, the two accepted LivenessNet runs); the 12 training cards of arm B of each accepted run (keys of the fitting and dev frames); with --estimator-check, the status.json and estimator_check.json of a check-estimator record. run, in addition: the image arrays of the cache, loaded whole into the frame store; of all the frames it assembles only the fitting and dev frames of arm B (an explicit check refuses any other role); it reads back its own checkpoints. check-estimator: what pad_arch_run.cmd_check_estimator reads (the configurations of PRs #27 and #28, what nuaa_bn_recalibration.load_inputs and nuaa_bn_test.load_bnrecal read: the M2 manifests, cache and extracted frames file, the cells and folds runs, the parent run at patience 4 with per model card, dev scores, threshold and checkpoint, its aggregate.json only as bytes, the BNRECAL run with dev and fitting rows only); it assembles only fitting and dev frames. No command loads the fold schema (fold<k>_test.csv) or opens a <model>_test_scores.csv
